$comment: Bindings from source paths to the docs that must describe them. Enforced by scripts/check-doc-drift.mjs (npm run docs:check). Two rules: (1) every anchor must appear in every bound doc, always; (2) if a change set touches a bound source path, it must also touch the bound docs. Rule 2 is scoped to the current change set, so a doc is never flagged for an edit made three commits ago. Advisory bindings warn but never block.

bindings.why: The local-CLI agent execution engine spawns child processes with credential passthrough. A reader who cannot find it in ARCHITECTURE.md will not know it exists.
server.ts is the registered MCP tool surface and README carries the tool table. Adding or removing a tool changes that table.
WIKI.md is the operator reference. The five executor tools have a call order that must be followed, and an operator who cannot find it will drive the run wrong.
Every outbound call is a trust-boundary crossing and must be enumerated in DATA_FLOW.md.
Report persistence writes signed artifacts to .mcp/reports/. The key handling belongs in the data-flow doc.
The gate pipeline diagram in ARCHITECTURE.md is drawn from policy.ts. A pipeline change invalidates the diagram.
What an unsigned chain does and does not guarantee is the single most over-readable claim in this project.
This engine writes to user IaC files. Behaviour changes must be documented before they ship.

WIKI.md is the operator reference and has no cloud-controls chapter at all, despite this being a 1,002-rule engine that auto-writes to user infrastructure files. Advisory rather than blocking because writing that chapter is its own piece of work, not a doc-sync edit. Tracked debt, not silent debt.

The five SVGs are hand-rendered and embedded in README via absolute main-branch URLs, so a branch edit is invisible until merge. There is no renderer in the repo. Advisory so the staleness is tracked debt rather than silent debt.
